definition_of_done: All pending migrations applied in order
`scripts/sync-agent-assets.sh` completed and all skill/agent symlinks verified
Visual test scaffolding ran (or was skipped with warning if unavailable)
Visual test reconciliation ran all 6 checks on new files
E2E test generation ran for features with Gherkin and no existing tests
Migration summary displayed with visual and E2E results appended
execution_tasks: Lock goal contract via `livespec goal render spec-migrate --save`
Emit `/goal` slash command with contract/state file reference
Read .specs/.livespec-path; resolve from skill symlink chain if missing
Verify resolved path contains a VERSION file
Write .specs/.livespec-path if freshly resolved
Read .specs/livespec-version (default: 1 if missing)
Read VERSION from LiveSpec repo
Skip to Phase 4.5 if project version already matches repo version
For each pending version: read migrations/N/migrate.md and execute migrate.sh
Stop and report on non-zero migration script exit
Verify sync-agent-assets.sh has completed and all skill/agent symlinks resolve
Verify .specs/livespec-version matches VERSION from repo
Read and validate .specs/surfaces.yaml if present
Log surfaces with unsupported runners; skip test scaffolding if no Playwright surfaces
Run migrate-visual-tests.js --generate (guard on script and Node.js availability)
Parse VISUAL_SCAFFOLD_RESULT sentinel for FILES/DIRS/ROUTES counts
Stage scaffolded files to establish rollback boundary
Run Check 0: classify each new spec.ts as VISUAL/NON-VISUAL/AMBIGUOUS and delete non-visual files
Run Check 1: detect and remove duplicate coverage across entire test directory
Run Check 2: fix syntax errors from merge (unbalanced braces, double });)
Run Check 3: remove empty dead stubs from Preserved sections
Run Check 4: warn on orphaned route tests without matching route files
Run Check 5: verify slug/route/heading coherence and log warnings
Scan for features with Gherkin but no E2E test file
Filter non-visual features using Check 0 results or fresh classification
Read route files, component source, fixtures, and existing tests for context
Generate complete e2e-NNN-slug.spec.ts files with real selectors and assertions
Verify generated files compile (TypeScript check if available)
Display migration summary with version range and validation results
Append visual scaffolding summary (files created, baseline dirs)
Append reconciliation summary (fixes, warnings per check)
Append E2E generation summary (files created, features skipped)

preconditions: - `.specs/` directory exists with a previous LiveSpec version.
purpose: Upgrade a LiveSpec project to the latest version by running pending migrations.
